notes: QrAndShareFlow (SupportingScreens.kt:655), reached from the dashboard's QRShare shortcut. State is a plain string, not an enum. "Preview" generates a "Premium Comp Card" with a simulated PDF download (fake progress via a delay(150) loop, no real file, no real QR payload). No schema exists for this anywhere — no shareable-link record, no download/share analytics. Does not call DynamicLinkManager.kt, despite that existing elsewhere in the app for outbound share links.
